# sherpa-node

One node of a node editor: a card on a [sherpa-layout-canvas](sherpa-layout-canvas.md), at its data-x and data-y. Its HEADER names it, drags it and may carry the whole node's sockets; its content holds its rows. Will, TODO 78. ## When to use it

For one step of a flow on a `sherpa-layout-canvas`: a card the reader drags by its header, which reports each move and asks to be selected. Its header names it and may carry the whole node's sockets, each its type's shape and ink (a value a circle, an object a diamond, a boolean a square) and hollow until a connection joins it; its rows are `sherpa-node-row`. The host writes `data-current` on the one it selects, and `data-warning` on one given what it cannot use: the warning look, and its words in the header's tip. For a card in the page flow, use `sherpa-container`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-layout-canvas style="inline-size: 720px; block-size: 360px"><sherpa-node data-heading="Start" data-icon="play" data-x="40" data-y="40" data-output-socket="object" data-output-connected></sherpa-node><sherpa-node data-heading="Pick" data-icon="price-tag" data-x="40" data-y="200" data-input-socket="any" data-input-connected data-warning="Pick takes an object; it was given a boolean"></sherpa-node><sherpa-node data-heading="Condition" data-icon="function" data-x="360" data-y="40" data-input-socket="any" data-input-connected data-current><sherpa-node-row data-input-socket="object" data-input-connected data-label="Rows"></sherpa-node-row><sherpa-node-row data-input-socket="value"><sherpa-input-text data-label="Value" name="value" value="active"></sherpa-input-text></sherpa-node-row><sherpa-node-row data-input-socket="boolean" data-label="Group"></sherpa-node-row></sherpa-node></sherpa-layout-canvas>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-active` | boolean |  | the one picked node whose panel is shown, in a stronger ring; the HOST writes it |
| `data-caption` | text |  | the TAB on its top edge: what its step does or did, its time and rows ("Simulating… 1s"). A running tab leads with a play icon. Its host writes it |
| `data-category` | text |  | its kind's category, in lower case: sources \| custom-nodes \| variables \| math \| logic \| time \| utils \| collections \| output \| ai; each has its look |
| `data-chain-drag` | boolean |  | ⌘ or Ctrl held on a drag or an arrow asks to pull the nodes it joins: the app's Enable node chain dragging setting writes it |
| `data-chain-falloff` | `distance` `connections` |  | distance \| connections: what that pull falls off by, the distance along the connectors (none: it) or how many: the app's setting writes it |
| `data-collapsed` | boolean |  | collapsed: its rows show only their sockets, no label or field; a socket's tip names its row and says its value, and its name reads "Heading: summary". Its host writes it data-inputs, data-outputs how many sockets each side's stack holds, collapsed: the header's and the rows'. Its host writes them data-inputs-connected, data-outputs-connected the same, of the connected ones only: hiding the unconnected, the stacks hold these. Its host writes them |
| `data-current` | boolean |  | the selected node; the HOST writes it, one node of many |
| `data-description` | text |  | a line under the name |
| `data-heading` | text |  | the node's name, in its header |
| `data-hide-unconnected` | boolean |  | collapsed, a socket no connection joins hides; a hover shows them. Its host writes it |
| `data-icon` | text |  | a glyph before the name |
| `data-input-connected` | boolean |  | a connection joins the header's input: its socket is filled, else hollow |
| `data-input-many` | boolean |  | the header's input takes several connections |
| `data-input-socket` | `value` `object` `boolean` `any` |  | the whole node's input socket, on its header: value (a circle) \| object (a diamond) \| boolean (a square) \| any (a grey circle) |
| `data-inputs` | number |  |  |
| `data-inputs-connected` | number |  |  |
| `data-joined` | boolean |  | joined to what is picked: downstream of a picked node, at an end of a picked connection, or joined to the row in focus. It wears the active border on its own fill. The HOST writes it |
| `data-kind` | text |  | its kind's name, where the node has a name of its own: the header says it first ("Field: Device type"). Its host writes it |
| `data-linked` | boolean |  | a portal of the picked portal's name, In or Out: it takes the picked look; the HOST writes it |
| `data-locked` | boolean |  | the host owns the place: a drag or a key reports, and moves nothing |
| `data-output-connected` | boolean |  | a connection leaves the header's output: its socket is filled, else hollow |
| `data-output-socket` | `value` `object` `boolean` |  | the whole node's output socket, on its header: value (a circle) \| object (a diamond) \| boolean (a square) |
| `data-outputs` | number |  |  |
| `data-outputs-connected` | number |  |  |
| `data-resizable` | boolean |  | the resize handle and Alt and an arrow exist: the app's Allow resizing nodes setting writes it. A saved size draws either way |
| `data-reveal` | boolean |  | the hidden sockets show, as on a hover: a line is being dragged. Its host writes it |
| `data-scale-h` | number | `1` | its height, in times its natural height: 1 to 2 |
| `data-scale-w` | number | `1` | its width, in times its natural width: 1 to 2 |
| `data-step` | `running` `done` `failed` `skipped` |  | how its step stands as a run lights it: running \| done \| failed \| skipped. Its host writes it. Running, the node wears the active border |
| `data-sub-graph` | boolean |  | it holds a sub-graph, as a Custom Node's use: a drill-down button on its header's end opens it (node-open). Its host writes it |
| `data-summary` | text |  | what its first field holds, in words: a collapsed node's name ends with it ("Condition: Equals"). Its host writes it |
| `data-warning` | text |  | what reached it that it cannot use, in words, a line each: it draws as a warning, and a hover or focus on its header shows the words. Its host writes it |
| `data-x` | number | `0` | where it sits across the canvas, in plane px |
| `data-y` | number | `0` | where it sits down the canvas, in plane px |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `socketRect(side: SocketSide)` | A socket's box on the screen, for a connector to join: the header's; null when it has none. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `node-move` | `{ x: number; y: number }` | It moved, or was asked to: a drag on its header, or an arrow key there. |
| `node-resize` | `{ h: number; w: number }` | Its resize handle was dragged, or Alt and an arrow pressed on its header. |
| `node-select` |  | It was pressed: a click on it, or Enter or Space on its header. |
| `node-open` |  | Its drill-down button was pressed: open its sub-graph. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | item | the node's rows: each a [sherpa-node-row](sherpa-node-row.md) |

## Settings it reads

Each of the app's settings, onto one of its attributes:

| Setting | Attribute |
|---|---|
| `resizeNodes` | `data-resizable` |
| `chainDrag` | `data-chain-drag` |
| `chainFalloff` | `data-chain-falloff` |
